tap.inline_hint: or press T · resets after 2 s

tap.title: Tap here to find the tempo
tap.measure: Tap at least twice to measure
alignment.hint: All distances are measured from the source. The reference mic is the farthest one, usually a room mic; the other mics get delay to line up with it.
alignment.delay_title: Delay to add · estimate, check by ear
alignment.stereo_warning: %s L/R differ by %s ms. Separate delays shift the stereo image; use one delay for both to keep it.
alignment.add_hint: Add each mic with its distance from %s. The delay to add appears here.
preset.name: Preset name
preset.save_hint: Saves %s, reference distance, units, sample rate and %s. The temperature is not saved.
preset.replace_hint: A preset called “%s” already exists. Replace it?
preset.load_hint: Loading replaces the source, reference, units, sample rate and mics. The temperature stays as set.
preset.delete_warning: Deleting a preset can't be undone; export your presets first to keep a copy.
preset.delete_hint: “%s” will be deleted. This can't be undone.
preset.renamed: Renamed because the name was taken: %s.
preset.invalid_file: the file is not a MusiCalc preset file
preset.wrong_kind: the file does not contain Alignment Delay presets
preset.unsupported_version: the file was made by a newer MusiCalc (preset format %d)
preset.missing_name: a preset in the file has no name
preset.invalid_reference: preset “%s” has an invalid reference distance
preset.invalid_mic: preset “%s” has an invalid distance for “%s”
sum.source_hint: The range is shaded on the graph and the frequency sets its cursor. A source picks a typical range; every value can be changed.
sum.compared: Mic B compared with Mic A
sum.combined_level: Combined level, dB relative to Mic A alone
sum.model: Model: the same signal reaching both mics, Mic B delayed and at the level and polarity set above. Room reflections and the mics' own response are not included. Check both mics summed in mono.
sum.enter_distance: Enter how much farther Mic B is from the source than Mic A: a distance, or a measured time in ms.
sum.aligned_detail: Mic B arrives %s ms later and Mic A is delayed by %s ms, so both line up.
sum.delayed_detail: Mic B arrives %s ms %s; Mic A is delayed by %s ms.
sum.no_difference: No time difference: the direct sound lines up.
sum.aligned_comb: None: with the direct sound aligned, every frequency adds up (%s dB).
sum.cancel_comb: Complete cancellation: with inverted polarity and no time difference, the two cancel at every frequency.
sum.reduced_comb: Every frequency changes by the same %s dB: inverted polarity with no time difference.
sum.shallow: with Mic B %.1f dB down the dips stay shallow
sum.invert_note: inverting its polarity swaps dips and peaks
sum.preview: Mic A delayed by %s ms. Listen to both mics summed in mono before you keep it; the dashed line is the response without the delay.
sum.lineup_title: To line up the direct sound
sum.lineup: Delay Mic A by %s ms (%s). Align previews it on the graph; whether it sounds better is a listening decision, as room-mic timing can be part of the sound.
sum.lineup_b: Mic B arrives first: delay Mic B by %s ms (%s) in your DAW. Whether it sounds better is a listening decision.
three.hint: Check one source at a time: its distance to its own mic and to the neighbouring mic. Neighbour gain is how much louder the neighbouring channel is (gain, sensitivity, pickup).
three.model: Direct sound only, assuming matched mics and the level difference above.
three.enter: Enter the distances from %s to both mics
three.meets_detail: The neighbouring mic is %s times as far from %s as its own mic.
three.threshold_detail: About 3:1 (2.97 to 3.03 : 1): right at the guideline, with no room to spare. Any closer and it falls below 3:1.
three.below_detail: The neighbouring mic is only %s times as far from %s as its own mic.
three.ratio: distance ratio, neighbour mic : its mic
three.level_equal: as loud as its own mic
three.better: %s dB better than the %s dB target
three.short: %s dB short of the %s dB target
three.because_louder: , because the neighbouring channel is %s dB louder
three.no_margin: No room to spare: keep the neighbouring mic at least %s from %s.
three.next_source: Now check each other source the same way.
three.margin_detail: The neighbouring mic may come as close as %s to %s, with the other settings unchanged.
three.turn_down: • Turn the neighbouring channel down by %s dB. This also lowers its own source.
three.or_turn_down: • Or turn the neighbouring channel down by %s dB. This also lowers its own source.
three.move: • Move the neighbouring mic to at least %s from %s.
three.or_move: • Or move the neighbouring mic to at least %s from %s.
three.aim: • Or aim its rejection at %s, then measure again.
three.comb_cancel: If both contributions were otherwise identical, mixing them could boost by up to +%s dB and cancel completely at some frequencies. Listen to both mics summed in mono.
three.comb: If both contributions were otherwise identical, mixing them could boost by up to +%s dB and cut by up to −%s dB, depending on frequency. Listen to both mics summed in mono.

preferences.scale_hint: %d%% follows desktop settings. Sizes may be rounded.
preferences.scale_override: Scale is set by FYNE_SCALE at launch.

sum.invalid_farther: Enter how much farther Mic B is as a number: a distance, or a time in ms.
sum.invalid_temperature: Enter a temperature from −40 to +50 °C (−40 to 122 °F); the distance converts to time through the speed of sound.
sum.invalid_band: Enter a range within 10 Hz to 20 kHz, with From below To.
sum.invalid_cursor: Enter a frequency the graph shows, %s to %s Hz, or leave it empty.
sum.invalid_level: Enter Mic B's level as a number of dB within a usable range.
sum.invalid_delay: Enter the delay on Mic A as 0 ms or more. If Mic B arrives first, delay Mic B in your DAW instead.
sum.aligned_residual: Within the 0.01 ms steps, Mic B is still %s µs %s; the graph includes it.
sum.cursor_near: At %s Hz: below −60 dB, nearly complete cancellation
three.invalid: Enter positive distances and a gain in dB; one of the values cannot be used
three.comb_boost: If both contributions were otherwise identical, mixing them would boost by +%s to +%s dB depending on frequency: the spill is at least twice as loud, so nothing cancels. Listen to both mics summed in mono.
alignment.invalid_temperature: the temperature is not between −40 and +50 °C (−40 and 122 °F)
alignment.invalid_reference: the reference distance is missing or not a distance of 0 or more
alignment.invalid_mic: a mic distance is not a distance of 0 or more
alignment.invalid_delay: a distance is too large to count in samples
alignment.invalid_rate: the sample rate is not positive
alignment.invalid_distance: The new mic was not added: its distance from the source must be a number of 0 or more.
alignment.session_error: The last Alignment Delay setup could not be restored and was reset: %s.
preset.stored_error: Some stored presets could not be read and were left out: %s.
preset.store_error: The presets could not be saved: %s
sum.no_audible_comb: None below 20 kHz: across the audible range the level stays between %s and %s dB.
